banks.as_of: 30 Jun 2024 extract; current member page available
banks.panel_construction_path: Extract Note C15 from annual/interim financial statements; archive current voting-power page if a panel is needed.

banks.preferred_measure: Voting power (and subscribed capital in monthly statements)
banks.panel_construction_path: Download one official AfDB statement per month/year and parse member rows.
banks.principal_caveat: Do not mix the African Development Bank with the separately governed African Development Fund (ADF).

banks.institution: Arab Bank for Economic Development in Africa
banks.panel_construction_path: Extract Appendix I from each annual report; preserve the reported capital concept.
banks.principal_caveat: The member table is paid-in contributions; subscribed callable and authorized capital are different totals.

banks.institution: Central American Bank for Economic Integration
banks.preferred_measure: Subscribed-capital share + ordinary loan-decision voting power
banks.source_type: Official investor presentation + Constitutive Agreement / Board rules
banks.panel_construction_path: Extract the official capital table; preserve A/B and zero-face-value C shares; pair with Board decision rules.
banks.coverage_in_workbook: Complete capital and ordinary loan-vote extract (2024)
banks.principal_caveat: Authorized-capital percentages do not sum to subscribed capital. Loan-vote weights allocate underlying member votes; a shared-constituency director may cast several members’ votes as one bloc.

banks.institution: Development Bank of Latin America and the Caribbean
banks.preferred_measure: Subscribed-capital share + ordinary Board loan-decision seat share
banks.source_type: Official investor presentation + Constitutive Agreement / Board composition
banks.panel_construction_path: Retain the reported A/B/C category and rounded capital percentage; construct Board seats under arts. 24–27; archive each Board-composition period.
banks.coverage_in_workbook: Complete rounded capital and ordinary loan-vote extract (2024)
banks.principal_caveat: Capital shares are normalized from rounded percentages. Formal Board voting is one-director/one-vote; country-normalized power excludes the private-banking seat, preserves zero-seat countries as 0.00%, and uses principal-country attribution.

banks.panel_construction_path: Extract Note 19(c) from annual financial statements; one report supplies current and prior year.
banks.principal_caveat: Five UK territories are one voting member; capital shares and voting shares must be kept distinct.

banks.institution: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development
banks.panel_construction_path: Snapshot the shareholder page or extract capital tables from historical governance documents around each year-end.
banks.principal_caveat: EU and EIB are shareholders and belong in the denominator; the page does not state a formal as-of date.

banks.institution: International Bank for Reconstruction and Development
banks.panel_construction_path: Save dated API/bulk snapshots or extract year-end membership schedules from annual financial statements.
banks.principal_caveat: The published dataset is the latest snapshot despite being labelled time series; basic votes make voting power differ from capital share.

banks.panel_construction_path: Save dated API/bulk snapshots or use replenishment/year-end schedules.
banks.principal_caveat: IDA is not share capital in the same sense as a bank; votes consist of subscription and membership votes under replenishment resolutions.

banks.panel_construction_path: Extract Schedule I-4 from each annual financial report.
banks.principal_caveat: Use IDB Ordinary Capital only; do not combine IDB Invest or IDB Lab. Additional paid-in capital does not affect voting power.

banks.as_of: Current page accessed 18 Aug 2026; as-of not stated
banks.panel_construction_path: Archive the member table and cross-check annual-report annexes/financial statements.

banks.principal_caveat: Displayed capital amounts are rounded, and the page does not give a formal as-of date; use reported percentage rather than recomputing from rounded amounts.

banks.panel_construction_path: Extract the shareholding structure from successive investor presentations or annual reports.
banks.principal_caveat: Prospective members are excluded until accession/subscription is effective; reported percentages are rounded.
